She later explored determinism, faith, neuroscience, and social justice; after an August 3 panel, she said by October 20 that she believed in free will. Suggested methods included literature review, mixed-method options, employee surveys/interviews, and quantitative and thematic analysis; sample measures and interview prompts were proposed. Stratified sampling, varied recruitment, piloting, and demographic checks were suggested, as were clear, unbiased questions. No methods were confirmed as adopted.
